description: Retrieves derived health statuses for release thresholds in a Sentry organization for a given time range, optionally filtered by environment, project, or release; `start` and `end` times must be provided together. **`[WARNING]`**: This API is experimental (Alpha) and subject to change!

inputSchema.description: Parameters to fetch release threshold statuses for an organization.

end.description: The inclusive end of the time series range for querying release threshold statuses. Must be in UTC ISO8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T23:59:59Z').
end.title: End

environment.description: A list of environment names (e.g., 'production', 'staging') to filter the release threshold statuses by. If not provided, statuses for all environments are considered.
environment.title: Environment

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the Sentry organization for which to fetch release threshold statuses.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

projectSlug.description: A list of project slugs (e.g., 'frontend', 'backend-api') to filter the release threshold statuses by. If not provided, statuses for all projects in the organization are considered.
projectSlug.title: Project Slug

release.description: A list of release versions (e.g., '1.0.0', 'my-app@2.1.3') to filter the release threshold statuses by. If not provided, statuses for all releases within the time range are considered.
release.title: Release

start.description: The start of the time series range for querying release threshold statuses. Must be in UTC ISO8601 format (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z').
start.title: Start

inputSchema.title: FetchOrganizationReleaseThresholdStatusesRequest

name: fetch_organization_release_threshold_statuses

FetchOrganizationReleaseThresholdStatuse.description: Response is an object keyed by '{release_version}-{project_slug}' format, where each key maps to an array of threshold status objects.
FetchOrganizationReleaseThresholdStatuse.title: FetchOrganizationReleaseThresholdStatusesResponse
